findings.title: Recovery codes in the user-storage fixture are never consumed
findings.body: The recovery-code validator only checks whether the submitted value is present in the stored JSON list and leaves that list unchanged. Consequently, a recovery code accepted once will be accepted again indefinitely, contrary to the one-time recovery-code contract. The new integration test logs in with only one code and therefore passes while this regression remains undetected. The fixture should mark the matching code as used/remove it in a way that is reflected by getCredentials(), and the test should attempt a second login with the same code and verify that it is rejected.
